title: Complete quadratic prefix bit
statement: For a Boolean vector $w \\colon \\mathrm{Fin}(n) \\to \\{\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{true}\\}$ and a natural number $k$, define its complete quadratic prefix bit to be the complete quadratic bit of the vector obtained by truncating $w$ through coordinate $k$.
caveat: The meanings of the truncation and complete quadratic bit are not fully given in the payload.
